mechanisms: Historical success used slow quasistatic tension feedforward, minimum 0.2 N, four antagonistic channels, a periodic smooth interpolation and native force balance.

content.title: T04 method selection: native feedforward, GVS NMPC, SoRoSim and RL
content.scope: Frozen timed 22 s figure-eight; no claim of global method optimality or current feasibility.
observations: Historical successful T04 used periodic quasistatic tension feedforward, not NMPC. Its 0.27 m single segment and 12 mm routing radius lie outside the current frozen family bounds; transfer the procedure rather than copying the hardware.

Current controller.gvs_nmpc@12.0.0 supports timed parameterized tracking and independent MuJoCo execution. A full 2200-update trial is in progress; sustained CPU use does not establish quality or acceptance.

controller.sorosim_matlab_nmpc@1.0.0 is registered, but its declared task_support is task.reach. The generated task gate rejects tracking and SorosimNMPCController.request reads static target_m. Timed reference objectives must be adapted and verified before using it for T04.

The existing PPO channel is available for reach and untimed geometric tracking. prepare_input rejects timed tracking and external-force scenes; presence of an RL channel does not establish original T04/M7 semantics.

Native quasistatic continuation reuses the existing SLSQP equilibrium construction and native mechanics, avoids 2200 online optimizations, and is supported by the historical low-frequency result. Dynamic tracking, cycle drift, tension saturation, stroke and speed remain unmeasured until full independent replay.
content.decision: Try native equilibrium continuation and independent full feedforward replay first. Keep GVS NMPC evidence. If model error or unmodeled dynamics defeat feedforward, compare adapting SoRoSim timed NMPC or residual RL with explicit task/observation/evaluation semantics; do not claim one failed route proves infeasibility.
content.limitations: Source-backed applicability and a prospective route choice, not a scientific success or an optimality proof.

content.title: Frozen-reference native equilibrium bank and feedforward replay
content.trigger: Slow periodic timed tracking with qualified native initial-state semantics and historical quasistatic evidence.
steps: Read expert-t04-history@1 and expert-t04-method-selection@1; verify all generated geometry stays within the frozen family space.

Generate a fresh candidate. Submit task.initial_state.construct@1.0.0 with its configuration_reference, strictly increasing reference_times_s starting at zero, max_iterations, and optionally named tension_reference_n for interior preload. Each time point consumes one mathematical evaluation.
Read reference_bank, maximum_static_balance_inf_nm, maximum_position_error_m, optimizer statuses and actual native cost. A numerical optimizer status alone is not equilibrium qualification.

Submit returned time-zero qpos_rad and tensions_n to task.initial_state.qualify, then task.protocol.bind with the owned qualification. Do not import nonzero trajectory velocities or bypass the independent gate.

Submit research.dispatch initialize_control with the bound candidate, method baseline and returned tension_knots. Core interpolates absolute tensions at control interval starts and executes zero-order hold; no shell, private interpolation or historical state is required.

Submit independent physical_replay for the complete frozen 22 s task. Read the original complete acceptance result, diagnose any dynamic/saturation/cycle failures, and SELECT only a fully passing current candidate.
content.limitations: Quasistatic hypothesis only. No trajectory acceptance from static points; no change to original hard bounds, qualification or evaluation grid.

content.scope: Original frozen T04 only; interface failure and prospective preload procedure, no current acceptance.
observations: Core 0.2.8 completed the full new native-bank physical rollout but its postprocessor raised KeyError phase_rad because the frozen reference omitted the declared zero default. Worker output, actual source SHA and costs remain retained; no acceptance exists for that call.

An 89-point native bank had maximum position error 0.602 mm and maximum static residual 5.10e-12 Nm, but included 0.2 N values. Those are static diagnostics, not trajectory success; the original strict no_saturation rule excludes tensions within 0.0001 N of either bound.

Core 0.2.9 normalizes the declared phase default and supports an optional tension_interior_margin_n in native construction. A 0.01 N inward margin restricts the search to 0.21..7.99 N inside the unchanged 0.2..8 N task box; seed/reference preload may be 4 N. Full independent qualification and trajectory acceptance remain mandatory.
content.procedure: Read skill-native-equilibrium-reference-bank@1. In construct supply tension_interior_margin_n=0.01 and named seed/reference tensions=4 N. Read actual bank residual/error; independently qualify time zero, bind, seed returned knots, then complete original physical replay. Reject numerical or physical failures honestly.
content.limitations: No change to task, generator bounds or acceptance thresholds. A narrower construction search box does not itself prove tracking, no saturation between nodes, drift or actuator limits.
